summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its subsidiary's leave-to-construct application with the Ontario Energy Board for the Orléans Area Reinforcement Project. The ~$100 million investment involves building an 11-km transmission line and upgrading existing lines to 230-kV to support Ottawa’s growing demand. This is a routine regulatory filing for infrastructure development, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or corporate event is involved.
